Here, the blur seems relatively consistent, but the transition between the sharp speaker edge and the background shows slight softness/haloing typical of generation artifacts.

The small red circular element on the left has an undefined, slightly melted geometry. It lacks clear structural logic (is it a button? a light? a strap loop?) and blends oddly into the surface, suggesting a minor generation artifact in fine detail rendering.
